Name: DPS Stat
Author: supercam19
Description:
DPS Stat is a mod that adds a visible damage per second statistic to melee weapon tooltips.

Additionally, the magic quiver trinket has its DPS displayed, and the ice rod trinket has its freeze uptime displayed.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.14 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Multiplayer Compatible
[/list]

[size=5]See also[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/supercam19/DPS-Stat]Source Code on GitHub[/url]
[/list]
